newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Alpha Leasing posts 8 pct rise in 1996 profi.
newsitem.headline: Greek Alpha Leasing posts 8 pct rise in 1996 profi.

text.p: Greek Alpha Leasing posted an increase of 8.0 percent in pretax profits to 7.09 billion drachmas in 1996 from 6.574 billion in 1995, its chairman Dimitris Matzounis told the annual shareholders' meeting.

"Our company continued its upward course in 1996," said Matzounis. "The growth in turnover is due to market demand, the active involvement of our employees and the branch network of Alpha Credit Bank."
Alpha Leasing is a subsidiary of Alpha Credit Bank, Greece's largest private bank.

Shareholders approved the board's proposal that a dividend of 650 drachmas per share be paid for fiscal 1996, an increase of 8.3 percent from 600 drachmas in 1995. The dividend is payable April 24. -- Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
